import sys

if __name__ == '__main__':
    if len(sys.argv) != 2 or sys.argv[1] != '--craftsman-soak-v1':
        raise SystemExit(0)
    from pathlib import Path
    with Path('probe_calls.txt').open('ab') as calls:
        calls.write(b'invoked\n')
    value = Path('probe_input.txt').read_text().strip()
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(('retained-stdout:' + value + '\n').encode('utf-8'))
    sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
    sys.stderr.buffer.write(b'retained-stderr:observed\n')
    sys.stderr.buffer.flush()
    raise SystemExit(7)
